name: Thermal-Physics-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework that embeds infrared radiative transfer modeling into the 3DGS representation, transforming Gaussian primitives into thermophysical radiative elements to enable physically interpretable infrared scene representation and novel view synthesis.
summary: Thermal-Physics-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting embeds infrared radiative transfer modeling into 3D Gaussian Splatting to enable physically interpretable infrared scene representation and novel view synthesis.
